model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021, based on NACE Rev. 2 classification. Each chart contains four segments, corresponding to the four sectors, with each segment labeled by its sector name, color, and percentage or absolute value. In the “NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES” chart, the “OTHER SERVICES” sector is represented by a large blue segment accounting for 61% (19.0 million enterprises), followed by “TRADE” (red, 19%, 5.9 million), “CONSTRUCTION” (blue, 12%, 3.7 million), and “INDUSTRY” (yellow, 8%, 2.4 million). In the “NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED” chart, “OTHER SERVICES” (blue, 51%, 80.2 million) is the largest segment, followed by “INDUSTRY” (yellow, 21%, 33.0 million), “TRADE” (red, 19%, 29.5 million), and “CONSTRUCTION” (blue, 9%, 13.4 million). In the “TURNOVER” chart, “INDUSTRY” (yellow, 33%, 10.6 trillion) is the largest segment, followed by “OTHER SERVICES” (blue, 31%, 9.8 trillion) and “TRADE” (red, 31%, 9.9 trillion), with “CONSTRUCTION” (blue, 6%, 1.9 trillion) being the smallest. All three charts use a consistent color scheme for each sector as defined in the legend: yellow for Industry, blue for Construction, red for Trade, and dark blue for Other Services. The charts include percentage labels and absolute values within each segment, and no segments are visually emphasized beyond their proportional size. The segments are arranged in descending order of size within each chart, starting from the largest at the top left and proceeding clockwise.
